digest.component_or_area: Plan-review Pass-2 prerequisite verification gate; Bedrock/Anthropic JSON Schema compilation
propositions: Commit 6c8daf7945 added exact-model-id row setting native_structured_output=True for sonnet-4-6, causing rebar to send JSON Schema to Bedrock for constrained decoding

Bedrock's grammar compiler enforces 180-second timeout and 24-optional-parameter limit; verification contracts carry 22-36 optional parameters (all fields have default= making them optional in JSON Schema)
Pass-2 prerequisite_verify step fails with HTTP 400 ValidationException after 180.6-185.9s, degrading every finding to no-verification and marking review INDETERMINATE/unsigned
output_mode must gate NativeOutput on both stack capability (outputConfig parameter support) and schema complexity (measured bound 16 optional/12 union parameters)
Schema-complexity rejections must be classified distinctly and logged with model/contract name, enabling fallback to PromptedOutput without silent signal loss
Defect affects both plan-review gate (plan_review_verification, 31 optionals) and code-review gate (code_review_verification, 36 optionals pinned to sonnet-4-6)
